quality_standard: Each mandatory gate must individually pass; never average or round.
protected: every existing real product and order

gates.title: Exact approved orbital identity
gates.criteria: Deep-black and luminous gold, central technology globe, official emblem, three separately controllable orbital rows, no old-theme CSS; reference screenshot approval by owner

gates.title: Mobile and desktop functionality
gates.criteria: All three rings use real links and work with touch, mouse, keyboard and accessible controls; no horizontal overflow, broken links or motion accessibility failures

gates.title: All pages and original text
gates.criteria: 100% parity of legacy+current URL inventory, titles, articles, 10 homepage guides, meaningful distinct original content on each page; no placeholders or lost routes

gates.title: All images and logo
gates.criteria: Owner-supplied official MojPlayWin logo matches reference; media/alt checked; no broken, missing or improperly substituted original images; license and sources verified

gates.title: Every mobile page Lighthouse Performance=100
gates.criteria: Lighthouse full 1.00 score for EVERY inventoried main-site page in repeatable mobile testing, not only a sample or rounded mean

gates.title: Every desktop page Lighthouse Performance=100
gates.criteria: Lighthouse full 1.00 score for EVERY inventoried main-site page in repeatable desktop testing

gates.title: Full accessible operation and Lighthouse=100
gates.criteria: WCAG 2.2 AA checked on all primary flows, keyboard, focus, contrast, semantics, reduced-motion, screen readers; Lighthouse accessibility=1.00 for all routes/devices

gates.title: Best Practices 100
gates.criteria: Lighthouse best-practices=1.00 on all routes/devices; no console/runtime errors, mixed content or vulnerabilities found in configured checks

gates.title: SEO 100 and correct canonicals
gates.criteria: Lighthouse SEO=1.00 on all routes/devices, correct self-canonicals, sitemap, robots, metadata, structured data, language and canonical domain checks

gates.title: Every existing real product intact
gates.criteria: Verified PRE and POST production Product inventory snapshots and hashes, identities, prices, currencies, discounts, stock state, owner, links, files, image and licenses match exactly

gates.title: Existing ETH and TRX gateways intact
gates.criteria: Wallet destinations, gateways, invoice/order/callback, S2S verification, idempotency, settlement and delivery untouched; tested with authorized non-charging sandbox/record-based smoke checks

gates.title: Django admin completely healthy
gates.criteria: Staff authentication and permissions, product/order/agent admin CRUD read-only smoke coverage; no production schema/model/settings migration

gates.title: Agents genuinely operational
gates.criteria: Staff-only view reflects verified heartbeat, queues, errors and success; agent ownership scoped to main MojPlayWin; no cross-site mutation or invented active status

gates.title: Security and privacy checks passed
gates.criteria: HTTPS/TLS headers, authorization, protected files, secret non-disclosure, XSS/CSRF, privacy notices and zero unresolved blocker-level security findings

gates.title: All protected sites unchanged
gates.criteria: Before/after baseline smoke checks on personal /mojtaba.roozegar/, independent MojPlayWin child sites, Zomorod Melal and its child sites; no page, SEO, DB or media loss

gates.title: Recovery and deployment fully isolated
gates.criteria: Validated restorable database, assets and application backup; tested rollback; deploy isolation prevents shared Passenger restart affecting protected sites

gates.title: Real service flows, support and contact
gates.criteria: All supported contact/support forms work, validated post-submit behavior and error states; no mock buttons or unsupported checkout claims

gates.title: Exact footer copyright year 2022
gates.criteria: Main-site footers read © 2022 MojPlayWin. All rights reserved.; separate Zomorod/personal site footers unchanged

gates.title: Owner-verified final live release
gates.criteria: Owner visual approval, independent live production smoke tests, full evidence package, every prior gate passed and deployment authorization
